changelog:
Initial release of feishu-chat-importer.

- Converts Feishu chat history exports into OpenClaw episodic memory format.
- Parses feishu_chat_YYYYMMDD.json files, normalizes messages, and groups them by date.
- Writes daily episodic summaries to memory/episodic/ for use in Imported Insights and Memory Palace.
- Supports dry run, date filtering, and verbose import options.
- Maps user and app messages to user and assistant roles accordingly.
- Ensures deduplication and proper content extraction for both text and post message types.
